'''Wraith Twelve''' was a [[Callsign/Legends|callsign]] for one of the members of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Wraith Squadron]]. For a long time the callsign meant [[Voort saBinring]].<ref name="Wraith Squadron" />
